@graph.name: Association Knowledge Audit
@graph.serviceType: AI governing-document audit for community association management companies

offers.description: Flat-fee audit of 2-3 associations' governing documents. Fewer than five findings and the audit is free. Fee is 100% credited toward a Deepvine deployment within 90 days.

@graph.description: Deepvine ingests 2-3 of a management company's associations' complete governing document sets into a private AI environment, identifies document conflicts, compliance gaps, and provisions to flag for attorney review, and delivers a written Findings Report with a deployment roadmap. Documents only: no system access, no owner PII in scope, no public AI used, certificate of deletion issued after delivery.

mainEntity.name: Does the audit require access to our management software?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. The audit is documents-only. You export folders of governing documents; we never request credentials to your management platform, accounting, banking, or email. System connections happen only in a full deployment, inside your environment.

On Deepvine's own private stack in the United States, under a signed data handling agreement. Your documents never touch a public AI tool or shared cloud model, are never used for training, and are deleted with a written certificate within ten business days of your report. On-site processing at your offices is available on request.
No. Owner ledgers, delinquency records, contact lists, and payment information are expressly excluded from audit scope. Most audit documents are recorded instruments that are already public record.

mainEntity.name: What if you don't find anything?

acceptedAnswer.text: Then the audit is free. If your Findings Report contains fewer than five documented findings, we refund the fee in full.

mainEntity.name: How long does the audit take?

acceptedAnswer.text: Your written Findings Report is delivered within ten business days of receiving your documents, and includes a live working session where you query your own portfolio with us.

mainEntity.name: Does the fee count toward a full deployment?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. One hundred percent of the audit fee is credited against a Deepvine deployment engagement signed within 90 days of your Findings Report.
